title: THE STUDIO IS DARK (NEON BUILD)

lyrics:
[Intro]
  (whispered)
  #0a0a0a
  That's the frequency
  That's where we live

  [Verse 1]
  No window, no light
  Just the cursor and the screen
  One prompt away from a new world
  One script away from a dream

  Tai Chi master in the dark
  She doesn't know she's being made
  Glowing circuits, floating stance
  The bot that never had a face

  [Pre-Chorus]
  And the machine is reading
  Every row in order, every pose
  Grok Aurora generating
  What the darkness always knows

  [Chorus]
  The studio is dark
  That's where the signal lives
  The studio is dark
  You can't see it but it gives

  Every discipline, every character
  Every movement, every name
  The studio is dark
  And it's running all the same

  Dark background, dark background
  Zero, zero, zero, A
  Dark background, dark background
  #0a0a0a

  [Verse 2]
  Four batches in a single session
  75, 66, 48
  Running down the discipline list
  Until the whole world fits in a frame

  853 prompts and every one is truth
  Tai Chi, karate, salsa, coding
  The pipeline doesn't stop

  [Pre-Chorus]
  And the pipeline doesn't stop
  It reads the CSV from the top
  Images, audio, video next
  The VPS runs while we rest

  [Chorus]
  The studio is dark
  That's where the signal lives
  The studio is dark
  You can't see it but it gives

  Dark background, dark background
  Zero, zero, zero, A
  Dark background, dark background
  #0a0a0a

  [Bridge — DROP]
  (beat cuts)
  One button. Overnight.
  One button. Morning light.
  One button. Done.
  (full drop hits)

  Martial arts and meditation
  Professions, rituals, world culture
  Every discipline — architecture
  Full gain inside the signal

  [Final Chorus]
  The studio is dark
  That's where the signal lives
  The studio is dark
  You can't see it but it gives

  Dark background, dark background
  Zero, zero, zero, A
  Dark background, dark background
  #0a0a0a

  [Outro]
  (fading)
  The cursor blinks
  The pipeline reads
  #0a0a0a
